contracts.semantic_role: Catalog governed Markdown, JSON, registry, governance, department, script, and program-narrative source records represented by the legacy classifier.
contracts.exclusion_rule: Exclude workspace-only, generated, transient, and unresolved records.
contracts.identity_rule: normalized governed-relative path plus content hash when available; preserve raw path.
contracts.field_precedence: governed source fields are authoritative; missing fields remain null/unknown.
contracts.determinism_rule: stable class-aware identity ordering and explicit null semantics

contracts.semantic_role: Catalog observable workspace files and directories, including tooling/runtime corpus records.
contracts.inclusion_rule: Include PHYSICAL_FILE, PHYSICAL_DIRECTORY, and TOOLING_OR_RUNTIME_CORPUS rows.
contracts.exclusion_rule: Exclude governed-source classified rows, generated/history, transients, and unresolved legacy rows.
contracts.identity_rule: normalized workspace-relative path plus artifact type; retain raw path and file/directory kind.
contracts.field_precedence: current bounded workspace observation, then governed source metadata when the row is also source-linked.
contracts.determinism_rule: stable class-aware identity ordering and explicit null semantics

contracts.semantic_role: Catalog generated reports, campaign outputs, historical outputs, and build products.
contracts.exclusion_rule: Do not treat generated content as authoritative source; do not merge it into governed-source identity.
contracts.identity_rule: generator or build class plus normalized output path; add content hash and generation record when available.
contracts.field_precedence: generator manifest and content hash precede observed filesystem metadata.
contracts.determinism_rule: stable class-aware identity ordering and explicit null semantics

contracts.semantic_role: Catalog caches, temporary records, database files/sidecars, and runtime-only products for compatibility and diagnostics.
contracts.exclusion_rule: Exclude from default authoritative production projection; expose through compatibility/diagnostic view.
contracts.identity_rule: normalized path plus transient/database class; sidecars retain parent database linkage when discoverable.
contracts.field_precedence: runtime observation only; never promotes authority.
contracts.determinism_rule: stable class-aware identity ordering and explicit null semantics

contracts.semantic_role: Retain traceability for missing historical directories and legacy-unresolved records.
contracts.exclusion_rule: Never silently delete or merge until human disposition.
contracts.identity_rule: legacy row id plus raw path and provenance snapshot; normalized path is secondary.
contracts.field_precedence: legacy record preserved as historical reference; no current source override.
contracts.determinism_rule: stable class-aware identity ordering and explicit null semantics
